title: iso20022-evidence-pack-mcp
description: Fully local, closed-world Model Context Protocol server for the ISO 20022 MCP Suite: the audit and certification sibling of iso20022-readiness-suite-mcp. It compiles a readiness result, remediation diffs, and simulated bank responses into one sealed, exportable audit evidence pack. The seal is a deterministic SHA-256 digest over the pack's canonical JSON (digest field excluded), making the pack tamper-evident: re-sealing identical content yields the identical digest, and changing any field breaks verification. No network surface, no sub-servers, no XML. Exposes 4 read-only tools over stdio: fold a graded, sealed pack from readiness/remediation/simulation inputs (build_evidence_pack); compute a pack's deterministic seal (seal_pack); recompute and compare a seal to an expected digest (verify_seal); render a pack as a markdown compliance report (render_markdown). The seal is an integrity digest for tamper-evidence, not a cryptographic signature; signing (keys/PKI) is a roadmap item. SLSA Build L3 provenance + PEP 740 sigstore attestations + CycloneDX/SPDX/licenses SBOMs on every release; NIST SP 800-218 SSDF practice IDs mapped in SECURITY.md.
